name: PPO
description: PPO (Stable-Baselines3, default hyperparameters) trained on PortfolioEnv: 252-session random-start episodes, reward = log equity change net of fees, softmax-over-logits long-only weights with cash. Observes causal scale-free per-asset features, current weights and cash. The checkpoint with the best validation Sharpe is kept. No tuning: trials counts this single configuration.
